name: neobrutalism-selects
title: Selects
description: Neobrutalism-style select components built with Tailwind CSS. Featuring thick borders, hard shadows, and custom dropdown styling. Great for forms, filtering options, and menus with a bold, high-contrast design.
useWhen: Choosing one option from a known list in a high-contrast form or filter.
Grouping related options while preserving native selection behavior.
avoidWhen: Users need to choose several values — use checkboxes or a multi-select.
The option set is large enough to require search.
responsiveBehavior: Select controls fill their container on mobile and keep their native or custom indicator visible. Option groups remain readable when the menu is opened.
accessibility: Use a visible label connected to the select element.
Use optgroup labels for grouped options and do not rely on styling alone.
